content.data: We want to migrate self-managed PostgreSQL on EC2 to Aurora Serverless v2.
Good choice. I'll use DMS for continuous replication, then validate and switch over during a maintenance window.
We're on PostgreSQL 12. Is that a problem?
Yes, PG 12 is EOL. Upgrade to PG 15 on EC2 first, then migrate.
What about PostGIS, pg_cron, and pgvector?
All three are supported on Aurora PG 15 — no blockers there.
